steps.text: Step 1 runs the `explore` agent. It sees the workflow input. If it fails the workflow stops.

steps.gate: grep -q 'RISK: HIGH' && { echo "the risk assessment ended on RISK: HIGH" >&2; exit 2; }; exit 0
steps.text: Step 2 runs the `plan` agent. It sees the summary of step 1 (explore). When it finishes, the command `grep -q 'RISK: HIGH' && { echo "the risk assessment ended on RISK: HIGH" >&2; exit 2; }; exit 0` runs and an exit status of 2 stops the workflow. If it fails the workflow stops.
Step 3 runs the `general` agent. It sees the summary of step 1 (explore) and the summary of step 2 (plan). If it fails the workflow stops.
Step 4 runs the `general` agent. It sees the workflow input. If it fails, step 3 and this one run again, at most 2 times.
